subject.title: improve(ui): remove the Roundness appearance setting

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped browser-local Roundness preference now and make corner radius solely theme-owned?
rationale: The code removal is clean, but deleting a persisted user-visible appearance setting is a product/compatibility choice rather than a purely mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Accept theme-owned radius
options.body: Merge the current removal and own the visual-preference reset because the old setting was not applied on fresh startup.

options.title: Preserve or transition the preference
options.body: Keep the setting or add a visible transition path if maintainers want existing users to retain explicit roundness control.

recommendation.title: Accept theme-owned radius
recommendation.body: Merge the current removal and own the visual-preference reset because the old setting was not applied on fresh startup.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle authored the current PR and recently carried the settings UI surface through the full-page settings redesign.
